-- What a client importing `Proof.sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.merge.Laws` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def smd.reconcileMF_sorted.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (mf : List (GoString × smd.VSet)),
    smd.keysSorted mf = true → smd.keysSorted (smd.reconcileMF S t mf) = true

def smd.merge_size.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (l r : smd.UVal), (smd.merge S t l r).size ≤ l.size + r.size

def smd.prune_stages.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (merged : smd.UVal) (mf : smd.MF) (L : smd.VSet),
    ¬L.set.IsEmpty →
      mf ≠ [] →
        smd.prune S t merged mf (some L) =
          smd.addBackDangling S t merged
            (smd.addBackOwnedMF S t merged (smd.removeItems S t merged (smd.ensureNamed S t L.set)) mf) L.set

def smd.inputsSmall_prune.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (live config : smd.UVal) (mf : smd.MF) (mgr : GoString) (e : smd.VSet),
    smd.inputsSmall [live, config] mf →
      e.set = smd.fieldSet S t config →
        (smd.merge S t live config).size < smd.smdSizeMax ∧
          smd.FSet.card (smd.mfUnion ((smd.reconcileMF S t mf).set mgr e)).nodes < 2 * smd.smdSizeMax

def smd.conflictsMF_nil_iff.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (mf : smd.MF) (mgr : GoString) (c : smd.Cmp),
    smd.conflictsMF mf mgr c = [] ↔ (smd.conflictsOf mf mgr c).isEmpty = true

def smd.prune_size.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (merged : smd.UVal) (mf : smd.MF) (last : Option smd.VSet),
    (smd.prune S t merged mf last).size ≤ merged.size

def smd.reconcileMF_get.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (mf : smd.MF) (m : GoString),
    (smd.reconcileMF S t mf).get m =
      Option.map (fun e => { set := smd.reconcile S t e.set, version := e.version, applied := e.applied }) (mf.get m)

def smd.removeItems_size.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (x : smd.UVal) (R : smd.PathSet), (smd.removeItems S t x R).size ≤ x.size

def smd.MF.set_sorted.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (mf : smd.MF) (k : GoString) (e : smd.VSet), smd.keysSorted mf = true → smd.keysSorted (mf.set k e) = true

def smd.prune_conforms.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (merged : smd.UVal) (mf : smd.MF) (L : smd.VSet),
    S.WF →
      smd.conforms S t merged →
        (∀ (m : GoString) (e : smd.VSet), mf.get m = some e → smd.keysWithItems S t e.set) →
          smd.keysWithItems S t L.set →
            have p0 := smd.removeItems S t merged (smd.ensureNamed S t L.set);
            have p1 := smd.addBackOwnedMF S t merged p0 mf;
            smd.conforms S t p0 ∧ smd.conforms S t p1 ∧ smd.conforms S t (smd.addBackDangling S t merged p1 L.set)

def smd.MF.get_set.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (mf : smd.MF) (k : GoString) (e : smd.VSet) (m : GoString), (mf.set k e).get m = if m = k then some e else mf.get m

def smd.afterUpdate_sorted.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (mf : List (GoString × smd.VSet)) (mgr : GoString) (confl : smd.FSet (GoString × smd.Path)) (removed : smd.PathSet),
    smd.keysSorted mf = true → smd.keysSorted (smd.afterUpdate mf mgr confl removed) = true

def smd.conflictsMF_sorted.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (mf : List (GoString × smd.VSet)) (mgr : GoString) (c : smd.Cmp),
    smd.keysSorted mf = true → smd.keysSorted (smd.conflictsMF mf mgr c) = true

def smd.mfPairs_conflictsMF.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (mf : smd.MF) (mgr : GoString) (c : smd.Cmp), smd.mfPairs (smd.conflictsMF mf mgr c) = smd.conflictsOf mf mgr c

def smd.ensureNamed_nodes.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (s : smd.PathSet) (q : smd.Path), q ∈ smd.ensureNamed S t s → q ∈ s.nodes

def smd.fieldSet_nodes.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (x : smd.UVal), smd.FSet.card (smd.fieldSet S t x).nodes ≤ x.size

def smd.mfUnion_nodes.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (mf : smd.MF) (m : GoString) (e : smd.VSet),
    mf.get m = some e → smd.FSet.card e.set.nodes ≤ smd.FSet.card (smd.mfUnion mf).nodes
